edges.reason: Owner is initialized directly from msg.sender in the constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before staging a new owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner gates the privileged token rescue function on msg.sender.
msg.sender is used as the source balance key in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender key in allowed during transferFrom.
msg.sender is written into allowed and forwarded to receiveApproval.
The 'to' parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
The 'tokens' parameter drives the balance arithmetic in transfer.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
transfer delegates balance debiting to safeSub.
transfer delegates balance crediting to safeAdd.
transfer performs arithmetic mutation of balances that depends on token amounts.
transferFrom debits the balance of the 'from' parameter.
transferFrom credits the balance of the 'to' parameter.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter for both balance and allowance arithmetic.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decreases the allowed mapping for the spender.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom performs balance and allowance arithmetic on user-supplied amounts.
approve stores the allowance for the spender parameter.
approve stores the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
approve writes the allowed mapping without a double-spend guard.
approveAndCall grants the allowance to the spender parameter.
approveAndCall uses tokens for the allowance and the callback argument.
approveAndCall forwards the data parameter into the external callback.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an arbitrary spender contract, enabling reentrancy.
The receiveApproval callback can re-enter approveAndCall and rewrite allowances.
Transfer of ownership is staged with an owner-supplied address parameter.
The untrusted tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract to call.
The tokens parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an untrusted token contract that may re-enter.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.

Constructor mints the whole supply into a hard-coded balance.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner state variable.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears the pending owner state variable.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable from the caller.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient argument is only meaningful as data flowing into transfer's balance update.
Token amount argument is consumed by the arithmetic inside transfer.
Debited account argument is only used inside transferFrom.
Credited account argument is only used inside transferFrom.
The amount parameter directly feeds the balance and allowance arithmetic.
Spender argument is used solely as the allowed mapping key in approve.
Allowance value argument is stored directly by approve.
Spender argument becomes the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
Amount argument is both granted and forwarded to the external callback.
Arbitrary data argument is passed straight into the external callback.
Candidate owner argument only populates the newOwner state variable.
Untrusted address argument determines the target of the external transfer call.
Amount argument is forwarded verbatim to the external token transfer.
